descriptionChirho: A Levitical city in the hill country of Judah (Josh 15:50, 21:14; 1 Sam 30:28; 1 Chr 6:42). All three clusters represent the same proper-noun referent: the bare nominative and conjunctive forms (eng: Eshtemoa / and-Eshtemoa, spa: Estemoa / y-Estemoa, arb: أَشتَموعَ / وَ-أَشتَموعَ, kor: 에스드모아, swa: Eshtemoa), a variant spelling Eshtemoh (eng: and-Eshtemoh, spa: y-Estemó, arb: وَ-أَشْتَموهُ, swa: na-Eshtemoa), and the locative with bet (eng: in-Eshtemoa, spa: en-Estemoa, arb: في-أَشتَموعَ, swa: Eshtemoa). All refer to the identical place.
